verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API is inherently headless (REST endpoints for cards, users, transactions, disputes) and provides a sandbox with simulation endpoints for automated testing (marqeta-docs-10, marqeta-docs-14, marqeta-docs-19, marqeta-docs-35), which supports scripted/CI-style workflows. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, SDKs, or automation tooling for running scripted test suites in pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guides, official SDK/CLI for automated test runs, and any mention of headless orchestration beyond the general sandbox/simulation API.
